group.passage:
When it comes to hair, textures and colors are what most people care about. Few would delve beneath the surface and wonder what lies below. The hair science we are going to cover will prove there’s more to our hair than meets the eye.
Let’s start with the hair structure. Every strand of hair has a shaft and a root. The shaft is the visible part that extends beyond the outer layer of the skin, while the root is in a deeper layer. (A) <u>The root is surrounded by a hair follicle, a sock-like structure in charge of hair growth.</u> At the very base of a hair follicle lies the hair papilla, which is made up of blood vessels and supplies oxygen to hairs. Fed by these blood vessels is the bulb, also at the lower part of the hair follicle. The bulb is responsible for making new hair through the division of stem cells every 23 to 72 hours. Located in the middle part of the hair follicle and attached to arrector pili muscles, the bulge contains stem cells for the surface of the skin, which help with healing after a wound. It is amazing to see such a complicated network at work beneath our scalp.
What’s inside our hair is equally complex. It has three different layers. At the center is the almost invisible medulla, which is not present in thinner hairs and whose function is not yet identified. The middle layer, also the thickest, is the cortex. Made up of keratin, a protein found in our fingernails, the cortex is where the strength of a hair comes from. The outermost layer is the cuticle. (B) <u>This layer is formed by overlapping cells, like roof tiles, and serves as a shield for the hair.</u> Together these three layers create a very strong fiber. (C) <u>As thick as a piece of paper, a single strand of hair can hold a weight of up to 0.1 kg!</u>
(D) <u>Like everything else in life, we tend to ignore something as insignificant as a strand of hair.</u> After exploring the ins and outs, we now can give credit where credit’s due.

figures.description: 題目右側一張灰階的皮膚剖面示意圖：上方有一條代表皮膚表面的曲線與波浪線，下方灰色區域為皮膚深層；一根頭髮從皮膚內斜向右上方伸出皮膚表面。皮膚內包住髮根的是一個斜向、袋狀（襪子狀）的毛囊，毛囊最下端膨大成球狀並包住底部一個小突起。四條引線由右側標示：A 指向伸出皮膚表面之外的頭髮（毛幹）；B 指向從毛囊上部斜向右上方延伸的細條狀肌肉組織（附著在毛囊上）；C 指向毛囊中段、B 所指肌肉附著處下方的部位；D 指向毛囊最底部、被球狀膨大部分包住的小突起。

questions.stem: Which of the following does NOT contribute to the growth of hair?
Which of the following statements about the three layers of hair is true?

options.A: Not everyone’s hair has three layers.
options.B: The cortex can also be found in our fingernails.
options.C: The medulla is likely the most important of all.
options.D: The cuticle is the outer layer with a smooth surface.
